description: Asrai's Outlook Scout: the odds that a coin is HIGHER or LOWER after 3 or 7 days, published 4 times a day for coins with a real, backtested edge (exchange listings/delistings, deep sell-offs, many indicators agreeing) and scored on the real price afterwards. With a symbol: that coin's running outlook (odds, strength, reasons, likely range, the price that proves it wrong) and how past outlooks on it did; without: every running outlook, strongest first, and the 30-day win rate. 46–54% is a normal week (a coin flip), so a coin with no outlook has no clear edge right now. Use for: 'outlook for X this week', 'is X likely to go up', 'which coins are likely to drop'. Outlooks, not trade advice. Free.

symbol.description: Coin ticker, e.g. 'BLUR' (omit for all running outlooks)
